dialogues.speaker: Jayubal
dialogues.text: Ah... The last time I rode on a boat like this, Yohuana was there, carrying little Quemitl... Good times, those.

dialogues.speaker: Jayubal
dialogues.text: If she were still here, I'm sure Yohuana would love to take a seat right beside me.

dialogues.speaker: Jayubal
dialogues.text: Unfortunately, it seems the attraction isn't ready yet.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Want to give it a try?

dialogues.speaker: Jayubal
dialogues.text: I've got a little purple boat, floating about in my memories. I take a ride on it every day.
